messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — multiple 5xx and gateway timeouts observed across the public API in us-east-1. Severity: P1. Alert: gateway_5xx_rate > 5% (5m). Dashboard: https://monitoring.redwood/example/alerts/6789
Alex Chen: ACKing, I'm paged. Oncall stepping in. Anyone have scope? Is this global or region-specific?
Priya Rao: graphs show spike at 05:12 UTC, concentrated in us-east-1 frontends -> 5xx + upstream timeouts. 5xxs are primarily 502/504. Preliminary traces point to rate-limiter returning 5xx downstream when quota service times out.
Ben Wolf: I pushed a config to rate-limiter at 05:10 to tighten per-tenant buckets (PR #4242). Could be related.
Samir Patel: correlating deploys... yes, ben's config was rolled 05:10 via canary -> prod. Error curve lines up.
Maya Li: Customer impact: we see ~8% error rate for text-generation and embeddings endpoints. Top affected tenants: tenant-omega, tenant-lumen, tenant-nimbus (high traffic). Support already getting tickets.
Alex Chen: running runbook step 1: verify recent config diffs and roll back if suspicious. Priya can you paste the diff?
Priya Rao: diff snippet:
```
- default_burst: 1000
- per_tenant_limit: 100
+ default_burst: 50   # accidental reduction
+ per_tenant_limit: 10  # wrong units (should be 100)
```
Ben Wolf: I accidentally changed units in the template. Those low limits cause immediate queueing on the quota service and then downstream timeouts. I'm rolling back now.
Ben Wolf: running: `kubectl -n infra set configmap rate-limiter-config --from-file=config.yaml=./config/prod.yaml`
deploy-bot: Deploy started by Ben Wolf: rollout/rate-limiter-config (uid=abc123)
oncall-sre: @Alex Chen any help needed on routing? I can flip fallback to regional pool if rollback takes long.
Alex Chen: Good call. Two parallel mitigations: 1) revert config (Ben) 2) open fallback route to allow requests to be served by secondary pool (oncall-sre). Priya, Samir, monitor latency and 5xxs during ops.
Samir Patel: I'm enabling additional KV cache for hotspot tenants and raising circuit-breaker to 20s temporarily. Command: `curl -X POST https://ops.redwood/ops/circuit -d '{"timeout":20000}'`
Maya Li: Noting customer comms: draft message to top affected accounts and support triage created. ETA to rollback completion?
Ben Wolf: rollback applied at 05:20 UTC. deploy-bot: rollout complete (rollout/rate-limiter-config, status=successful).
deploy-bot: Rollout finished: rollout/rate-limiter-config (uid=abc123) - success
Alex Chen: Observability: 5xx rate dropping from 6.8% -> 2.1% in first 3 minutes. Latency trending down.
Priya Rao: Confirming, errors now 0.9% and continuing to fall. Request counts back to normal for most tenants.
oncall-sre: I opened the regional fallback at 05:22 UTC to carry overflow while rollback completed. Fallback removed at 05:28 UTC as traffic normalized.
Maya Li: Customer impact estimate: roughly 27 minutes of degraded service for 3 high-revenue tenants; support will send targeted notes. Creating incident ticket and customer impact spreadsheet.
Alex Chen: Handoff to oncall-sre for ongoing monitoring and postmortem. Action items:
- Owner (Ben): write postmortem draft and root cause (mis-typed units in rate-limiter config).
- Owner (Priya): attach dashboards and traces.
- Owner (Maya): customer outreach and impact log.
- Owner (Samir): propose guardrails to prevent unit/scale changes (validate config linter).
oncall-sre: Taking handoff. Put me as pager contact. I'll keep monitoring for 2h and escalate if any residuals.
Alex Chen: TL;DR: production 5xx spike caused by misconfigured rate-limiter limits pushed in prod; rollback + regional fallback mitigated; errors returned to baseline. Postmortem will follow. :white_check_mark:
Priya Rao: Adding one more note: add automated canary slo for per-tenant limit changes (tests should simulate high QPS tenant).
Ben Wolf: Sorry team — will include test + config linter in PR template.
Maya Li: Support to send initial notice in next 20m. I'll coordinate with sales for any outreach.
oncall-sre: Logging handoff complete. Closing pager thread but keeping incident ticket open for postmortem work.
Alex Chen: Great work, everyone.
